exception_message: bundle is not current training material

measured_cause.explanation: The Phase 6 read-only provenance audit reused a loader whose safety contract is for current training inputs. The exact archive was later retired from training eligibility, so the loader correctly rejected it even though Phase 6 requests no training and only needs to reconstruct the immutable historical record lineage of already-built packages.

repair_boundary: Permit one hash-bound read-only historical-lineage reconstruction from the verified archive, its frozen selection, exact budget record IDs, and passing probe results. Do not restore training eligibility, train, query a teacher, mutate an artifact, change any prompt, or change any gate.
